transcript: That’s Dad and me at a wedding, about twenty years ago. I barely recognize that version of myself. He was still around then, and the world still made sense. Dad went missing early in the outbreak. No call I could trust, no message, nothing that told me where he went. I keep looking at this picture like it’s gonna give me an answer. He always knew how to take a broken system apart and find the one thing everybody else missed. A lot of what’s keeping me alive came from him. I just don’t know if he’s still out there.
summary: Rich looks at an old wedding photograph with his missing father and reflects on what his father taught him.
